description: This is a Java class defining an abstract utility class for generating unique datatable test names within the Apache Fineract project. It includes a static method that creates a random string based on a referenced table name, utilized likely in integration tests.

classes.name: DatatableTestNameGenerator
classes.description: An abstract utility class providing a static method to generate unique datatable names for testing purposes.

methods.name: generateDatatableName
methods.description: Generates a unique datatable name string based on a given DatatableEntity, using a utility to create a random string prefixed with 'dt_' and the referenced table name.
